name: pi-config-gui
description: Local web app for editing Pi agent config files
//: src/cli.ts starts with '#!/usr/bin/env node'; tsc preserves it and scripts/postbuild.mjs re-asserts it plus the exec bit. engines is the RUNTIME floor for `npx pi-config-gui` (Node 20: global fetch, AbortSignal.timeout, node:http — nothing newer is used in shipped code). The DEV toolchain (vitest) needs a newer Node; see README.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && vite build && node scripts/postbuild.mjs
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
